Texas Faces Lawsuit Over 600,000 Voter Registration Delays

Texas is facing a lawsuit over a significant backlog of nearly 600,000 voter registrations that delayed processing as early midterm voting approaches. While one report indicates the backlog has since been cleared, another states the state is being sued over the issue.
